name: @base-screen/engine
description: Designer 会话、画布交互、检查器和工作台编排

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const walk=(d)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=d+'/'+e.name;if(e.isDirectory())walk(f);else if(/[.]js([.]map)?$/.test(e.name))fs.rmSync(f);}};walk('dist/common/vendor');" && vite build
scripts.lint: biome check src tests && node ../../tooling/checks/designer-ui.mjs && node ../../tooling/checks/designer-styles.mjs
